summary: Chat Progress rebuilt on StatusMatrix with ONE moving mark per turn. The CSS ring spinner is gone. New forms: waiting and streaming status rows (the thinking row's matrix hands over in place to its ending — failed and stopped keep the same element); reasoning under a five-line capped, faded body; a thought chain on a 16px node lane with kind glyphs, chips, prose, one level of branches, a failed status with Retry and a 40px tabular clock; parallel lanes drawn as the activity pill's box (glyph, 104px name, activity, clock, chevron) that open to their own chain. Only the deepest running node moves — the root when parallel or folded, none when isHeld — and a run that finishes while mounted folds to its receipt. Stop past ~30 s and a stoppedText ending. The geometry spec now measures the lane pill (sheet 4040-0) instead of the old step list.

migration.manual: BREAKING: steps take `status: "done" | "current" | "pending" | "failed"` with optional icon, duration, chips, detail and one level of `steps`; the spinner and its data-slot are gone (the row's mark is a StatusMatrix with data-slot="status-matrix"). Pass isHeld to every ChatProgress in a turn except the live edge. Rows are 17.55px at the body-sm role's leading rather than the old 16px.
